evidence.text: From Altra's own Q2 numbers, Q3 2026 profit from property management works out at roughly 400-415 MSEK against the 399 MSEK Modular consensus. Q2 printed 381, including an SEK 8m early-redemption cost (about 389 underlying). In 2025, NOI rose seasonally from Q2 to Q3 (625 to 656), but consensus NOI of 638 sits only 6 above Q2's 632. evidence.why_not_priced: Consensus NOI of 638 is only +6 on Q2 against a seasonal +31 a year earlier, which reads as an under-modelled seasonal effect, an FX assumption, or the divestments modelled for the full quarter. If the market already expected about 410, the Modular bar would sit there rather than at 399. It cannot be distinguished from a deliberate analyst assumption, though (SEK strength, timing of the disposals), and the 4.3% run-up in the five days before the print may already price a small beat.

Earlier profit warning (15 Jul) cut the guide from 135-165 to 120-140 and pre-released Q2; H1 net debt/adj. EBITDA 2.5x, 9M adj. EBIT now 33.7+26.1+17.8 = 77.6.
Capital markets day moved from December 2026 to spring 2027; Q3 webcast to include a short ARC strategy update and an Oral Health presentation.
Ex-dividend EUR 0.32 on 7 Oct 2026, which explains most of that day's -5.75% close and inflates the sealed 20-day run-up (-18.96%) by ~4 points.

new_in_release.expect: Reiterated at EUR 110-120m one day after being set; a further change is very unlikely. Commentary on Q4 (flu season, occupational-health sales pipeline) is the swing: the midpoint needs Q4 adj. EBIT ~37.4m against 45.0m a year ago (-17%) while Q3 ran -34% y/y.

Q3 operating cash flow and net debt after the Hohde completion are new; with LTM adj. EBITDA falling, leverage is likely near the 3x target before the EUR 275m Silmaasema cash payment. Leans negative, unknown size.
ARC strategy progress update and Oral Health introduction; could include further cost or restructuring action (positive) or nothing new. Sign unknown.
In line with the 20 Oct pre-release; items affecting comparability (Hohde one-offs, Inderes expected ~6m) and segment detail are new but below adj. EBIT.
No change expected; FY25 dividend paid in instalments, last ex-date 7 Oct.

evidence.text: The window opens the session after a same-direction profit warning, after a two-day fall of ~12% (7.09 on 16 Oct to ~6.24 at seal: -5.4% on 19 Oct, which Finnish retail attributes to a Danske downgrade, then -7.4% intraday on 20 Oct on ~1.2m shares). The only in-name analog, the July warning, was followed by +4.13% the next session (7.03 to 7.32) and 0.0% on the report day.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: warning day 15 Jul -7.38%, next session +4.13%, H1 report day 17 Jul 0.00%, following session -4.64% as estimates were cut (Yahoo daily bars). One observation, and here the bounce session and the report day are the same day.
evidence.why_not_priced: It is a claim about how much of the warning the price has already absorbed, not a hidden fact. If the market had fully priced it with no overshoot the stock would sit near the July post-warning level relative to earnings; instead it has fallen 12% for an ~11% cut to the FY EBIT midpoint, more than the -8.4% it took for a ~13% cut in July. Retail flow on the Inderes forum shows dip buying at 6.1. Weak: one analog and an inference.

evidence.text: The new guide still needs Q4 to improve on the run-rate: with 9M adj. EBIT at 77.6m (33.7+26.1+17.8), the 110-120m range implies Q4 32.4-42.4m against 45.0m in Q4 2025, so the midpoint needs -17% y/y after Q3's -34%, helped only partly by a full quarter of Hohde, while the company says Q4 demand stays challenging.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide was cut twice in 2026 (15 Jul, 20 Oct), each warning day about -7%; Q3 2025 report fell ~8% on weak demand (Simply Wall St/webull aggregation, not re-verified).
evidence.why_not_priced: The guide is public, so this lands inside what the company already guided and is sized near zero. What is not yet in the price is the management tone on Q4 on the call; if the market believed the low end it would be trading as though a third cut were coming, and the -7.4% on the day is about the size of the July reaction, not larger.
evidence.independence: Q4 2025 adj. EBIT derived from FY2025 156.3m less Q1-Q3 2025 (47.8+36.7+26.8) in the Q1 and H1 2026 releases: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b7edaeb3902fff63c6b336ba2b5cf9e17&lang=en&src=listed . Same issuer, different documents.

evidence.text: Leverage is near the target ceiling before the biggest deal closes: net debt/adj. EBITDA was 2.5x at H1 (target no more than 3x), Hohde completed on 4 Sep, LTM adj. EBIT is now falling quarter by quarter, and Silmaasema still needs a EUR 275m cash payment, so the Q3 balance sheet in the release is a line the market has not seen.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print where leverage was the surprise; 2.4x (Q1) and 2.5x (H1) passed without a visible reaction.
evidence.why_not_priced: Q3 net debt has not been published and the warning carried no balance-sheet line. If the market were worried about funding, the bond or a rights-issue rumour would show; neither does. The money buys acquisitions (Hohde, Silmaasema), not distress, so the sign is small and negative only because EBITDA is shrinking under it.
